question: What ritual deficiencies are identified regarding the five cow products and five nectars?
premises: The five cow products may be lacking.
The five nectars limb may be lacking.
Both are components of ritual procedure.
inference: Deficiency may occur in the use of the five cow products or in the limb involving the five nectars.
uncertainties: The consequence of these deficiencies is continued in the next verse.
plain_english: This refers to cases where the five cow products are lacking, or where the part involving the five nectars is lacking.
